dialogues.jp: 「いや、やっぱり自分のことは自分でやるよ」
dialogues.en: "Well, I should take care of it by myself."
dialogues.text: "Well, I should take care of it by myself."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「え〜、じゃないっての。勉強は自分でやらな
　きゃ身につかないと言うしな」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, I am sure! I think it's more efficient if you study by
yourself."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, I am sure! I think it's more efficient if you study by
yourself."

dialogues.en: I nod with my arms folded.
dialogues.text: I nod with my arms folded.

dialogues.jp:
それに、さくらと勉強しようとしても、音夢を
巻き込んで騒ぎになるだけかも知れん。
dialogues.en:
Besides, if I study with Sakura, I know it could cause
trouble if Nemu gets involved.
dialogues.text:
Besides, if I study with Sakura, I know it could cause
trouble if Nemu gets involved.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ねぇ、お手て繋がなくてもいいからやろう
　よ〜」
dialogues.en:
"C'mon, let's study together, even if you don't need to hold
my hand."
dialogues.text:
"C'mon, let's study together, even if you don't need to hold
my hand."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「こらっ！　足にしがみつくな！」

おお、軽いから、さくらがしがみついたまま持
ち上がるぞ。
dialogues.en:
She's light enough that I can lift her body even while she
is hanging on to my leg.
dialogues.text:
She's light enough that I can lift her body even while she
is hanging on to my leg.

dialogues.jp:
結局、夕暮れまでさくらに追いまわされてテス
ト前日の貴重な時間を失った。
dialogues.en:
After all that, I wasted my study time being chased around
by Sakura until dusk.
dialogues.text:
After all that, I wasted my study time being chased around
by Sakura until dusk.

dialogues.jp:
自分のことは自分でやろうと思ったら、今度は
逆に、さくらに一緒にやろうとせがまれる。
dialogues.en:
When I decided I should study by myself, Sakura begged to
study with me.
dialogues.text:
When I decided I should study by myself, Sakura begged to
study with me.

dialogues.jp:
そんな風にじゃれているうちに日が暮れてし
まい、貴重なテスト前の時間を潰してしまっ
た……。
dialogues.en:
I didn't get any time to study for tomorrow's test, because
we were messing around with each other until dusk.
dialogues.text:
I didn't get any time to study for tomorrow's test, because
we were messing around with each other until dusk.
